profile.summary: The Berkeley School of Social Welfare is the social work school of the University of California, Berkeley, a public university. It offers a Bachelor of Arts in Social Welfare, a Master of Social Welfare and a PhD in Social Welfare. The school has worked since 1944 on research and training in social work practice and social policy.
